description: Use this tool for ANY compatibility / relationship / synastry question about two people — never estimate inter-chart aspects yourself and never web-search them. Relationship astrology for two birth charts: every inter-chart aspect (person A's points × person B's points, planets and angles) with exact orbs, plus house overlays (A's planets in B's houses and vice versa). Both full natal charts are embedded in the response.

include_minor_aspects.description: Also report minor aspects (semi-sextile, semi-square, quintile, sesquiquadrate, biquintile, quincunx) with tight orbs. Default false = the five major aspects only.

birth_datetime.description: ISO-8601 date-time WITH timezone, e.g. '1990-05-17T14:30:00Z' or '1990-05-17T17:30:00+03:00'. Convert the local birth time to an offset yourself; naive values are rejected.

house_system.description: House system; default 'placidus'. One of: placidus, koch, porphyry, regiomontanus, campanus, equal, whole_sign, topocentric, morinus, alcabitius

latitude.description: Birth latitude in decimal degrees (north positive)

longitude.description: Birth longitude in decimal degrees (east positive)

name: calculate_synastry
title: Synastry between two people
